description: This file defines the NotesRepository class for managing CRUD operations on Notes using SQLite database in an Android app. It provides methods to get all notes, retrieve a single note by ID, insert, update, and delete notes, interfacing with the database helper and mapping database cursors to Note objects.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A class providing CRUD operations for notes stored in SQLite database in an Android application.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the database, ordered by last updated time descending.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note with title and content, returning the new record's ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content, returning the number of rows affected.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning the number of rows deleted.

methods.name: cursorToNote
methods.description: Converts a database cursor to a Note object.
